# Algegram

> Algegram is an AI math tutor for students from elementary school through college, and for the parents and tutors who help them. Type or snap a math problem and Layla, Algegram's AI tutor, explains it step by step, from first fractions to calculus.

## Who it is for
- Students in grades 3 to 12 and college learners who want worked, step-by-step math help
- Parents and tutors checking homework
- Kids under 13 can use it with a parent's permission (required at sign-up); guests are never asked for personal details

## Plans
- Guests: 5 free questions, no sign-up
- Free account: 20 messages a day plus free topic quizzes
- Pro: $12.99/month with a 7-day free trial (adds photo solving, more daily help and practice tools)
- Learning centers: pilot programs are arranged directly; contact support@algegram.xyz

## Notes
- Algegram is clearly labeled as AI and shows no ads.
- We never save photos of math problems. The services that answer questions don't use them for training; they may hold a question or photo briefly to answer, and may keep one flagged by safety checks for review.
